responsibility: Implements default-channel LONGREAL text I/O as a thin wrapper over LongIO and StdChans. It forwards reads to LongIO.ReadReal on StdInChan and writes to the matching LongIO formatting routines on StdOutChan, supplying the standard-channel façade rather than its own parsing or formatting engine.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the wrapper implementation for SLongIO, forwarding LONGREAL input/output requests to LongIO with StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. It differs from SLongIO.def, which only declares the default-channel LONGREAL API.
